notes.title: Steam Developer Diary Post Sneak Out is Live - Commitment to Excellence and Play
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to share that Sneak Out is now available on Steam! Launching a game is always exciting, and we're fully dedicated to supporting and enhancing the game based on your experiences and feedback.

Current Issues & Our Actions:
We are aware that some of our players, particularly in China, have faced server connectivity issues. We're tackling this problem head-on with two approaches:

Directly resolving the server issues.
If unresolved, reverting to Steam's robust infrastructure to ensure a smooth gaming experience for everyone affected.
We've also heard your concerns about game balancing and the mechanics of item purchases. Please know that we're working diligently to address these points to improve gameplay and ensure fairness.

Looking Ahead:
Your input is crucial, and we're committed to making Sneak Out better with each update. For anyone impacted by the current issues, we will ensure that corrective actions are taken to compensate for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. Your enthusiasm and constructive criticism are what help us grow and improve. Stay tuned for updates as we continue to develop and refine Sneak Out.

Warm regards,
The Sneak Out Development Team


P.S.: A tip for players in the China region
To make sure you get the best gameplay experience for the moment, we recommend using game boosters UU and Xunyou Accelerator!

If for some reason you still don't know what Sneak Out is and have slept under a big rock for the last few months… Alright, let us summarize everything quickly for ya!

- Sneak Out is a  crazy multiplayer game filled with chaos and mischief
- Ultra fun for up to 6 players
- Escape as a hider or hunt as a deadly hunter!
- …or become a very helpful ghost :D
- It’s free to play! And, really, no pay to win!
- Customize your character, craft new skill cards and have fun at the lobby lounge!

Share the news, spread the word, gather your friends and see you soon in the game!

notes.title: How to play Sneak Out smoothly in China?
notes.content:
Hi players, to play Sneak Out online more smoothly in China, it is recommended that you use boosters to play. If one person in the game does not use the booster, the game may not be able to proceed normally.

How to use the booster, we take UU as an example to introduce the tutorial
1. First, go to UU Booster's official website to download and install UU Booster (https://uu.163.com/)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/40e3e587771c8309b227a5fd64c40a018839eca6.png

2. Open the UU Booster and search for Sneak Out in the upper right corner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/a8cbdc5191b1ab185a66cc7b049be196723701bc.png

3. Click "立即加速", and you can play Sneak Out smoothly in China after the acceleration is completed. It is recommended that players who play online should start acceleration to obtain a high-quality gaming experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/48e7d27c772a23882857663e9d6464ca1d1785a7.png

notes.title: Sneak Out - Thank you for participating in the playtests 🎉
notes.content:
Thank you for taking part in the 2nd Sneak Out Playtest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/19a12bc7905d73ed29d2d58b810dd5db7992ad22.png

Thank you to all participants of the Sneak Out Playtest (February 1-5, 2024 on Steam) for your enthusiasm and commitment! Your feedback is invaluable to us and duly noted for balancing work. 

:tools: Servers issues during playtest

We have decided to open the playtest fully to stress test our new server infrastructure. This test has shown that there are still critical issues to fix. We know exactly what they are and are currently addressing them. 

🗺️  Next steps - another playtest incoming

As soon as we fix the server issues, we will test again in the same way. This will happen sometime in February, possibly within 1-2 weeks. We will let you know in advance.  

:rocket: Full game release

Once we are confident that the servers are working smoothly, we will be moving forward with the release of the game. We are aiming for a full release in the first half of this year. Possibly early access earlier, but this will be decided based on testing results. 


With thanks,
The Sneak Out Team
